digest.component_or_area: Verified gate CI / macOS pytest cell
propositions: The macOS default-suite pytest cell selects tests via -m 'platform_compat and not external', a marker applied only at collection time by tests/conftest.py in the patchset tree.
Patchsets whose base predates the platform_compat auto-marker have zero collected tests matching the marker, causing pytest to exit with code 5 (no tests ran) and the gate job to fail.

The Verified gate runs _build-and-test.yml from trusted main (reusable-workflow ref binding) against the raw patchset tree, creating a definition-vs-tree skew where the marker definition exists in the workflow but not in the patchset.
The fix maps pytest exit code 5 to success on the macOS cell only, restoring pre-regression tolerance while keeping the speedup for current-tree runs.
Ubuntu cells remain unaffected and still fail on exit code 5, ensuring full test coverage and catching any current-tree marker regressions.
